title: Vintage Christmas Children Clipart Set
author: The Paper Princess
description:
This lovely clipart bundle feature Vintage Victorian Children. There 18 individual children in high resolution 300dpi PNG format on transparent background. 
These are ideal for card making, journaling, scrapbooking, graphic design and many other crafts.
